sources: HKJC RaceCard (English): https://racing.hkjc.com/racing/information/English/Racing/RaceCard.aspx?RaceDate=2026/11/18&Racecourse=HV&RaceNo=N for N=1..9; N=10..12 returned 'No information.'
Stored trip notes: /workspace/silks_ingest/hkjc_trip_notes/all_trip_notes.csv (255 rows; ST 2026-11-08, HV 2026-11-11, ST 2026-11-14).
limitations: Trip notes cover only the three reviewed meetings above; earlier form is not in this file.
Blank cells mean unknown, never zero or false.
traffic / wide_no_cover / slow_away and note/flags are replay-review observations unless source includes stewards; stewards_excuse, vet_finding and clearance_required are official stewards text.
Advertised going and course are from the racecard, not official race-day results.
No scratchings were listed on the cards at fetch time; late scratchings remain possible.
Standbys are not declared runners unless they later gain a start.
A horse declared tonight after a prior clearance_required note is not proof of official clearance (barrier trial / vet exam / stalls test passed). Those cases are flagged clearance_status=unverified.
Clearance horses absent from tonight's card are listed in clearance_flags with clearance_status=not_declared; we did not search later official clearance records.

rows.stewards_excuse: Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid VIEW ALL THINGS. Sent for sampling post-race.
rows.note: 3.8 fav, restrained from a wide draw, raced very keenly around the 1000m, then a sweeping wide sprint for 2nd

rows.stewards_excuse: Near the 50 Metres was inconvenienced when crowded between SETANTA and PERFECT PAIRING. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.vet_finding: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.note: three-wide without cover in the leading group and faded; official crowding near 50m not clearly confirmable; vet nsf

rows.stewards_excuse: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. Held up between the 500 Metres and the 300 Metres. Near the 1450 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by SPLENDID FORCE which shifted in. Near the 150 Metres became unbalanced when crowded between SPLENDID FORCE and COOL BLUE (S Osborne) which shifted out when held up behind SETANTA. S Osborne was advised to exercise more care. L Hewitson stated that his instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages. Trainer D J Whyte stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position but the horse settled further back in the field than intended. He added he issued those instructions as OCEAN IMPACT has run its best races when being ridden conservatively in the early stages.
rows.note: held up entering the straight and had to weave; official crowding near 150m not clearly confirmable from this angle

rows.stewards_excuse: Between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running. When being shifted to the inside of MASSIVE GLORY near the 250 Metres made contact with BRIGHT INHERITANCE.
rows.note: badly held up about 350-250m, momentum halted, then finished well for 4th
5.8 fav; three-wide without cover throughout according to the replay (not in the stewards report) and kept on for 3rd

rows.stewards_excuse: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.vet_finding: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.note: three-wide without cover for the majority and faded; vet nsf

rows.stewards_excuse: Prior to the running of the event Trainer W K Mo advised that the intention was to ride the horse where comfortable with cover as it was stepping up in distance and is a recorded "roarer”. M Chadwick stated that when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to settle slightly further back than he had intended to ensure that he was able to obtain cover. Leaving the 600 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of SPLENDID FORCE which had commenced a forward move.
rows.note: recorded roarer; settled further back than intended to obtain cover after being caught wide early

rows.stewards_excuse: Bumped shortly after the start. After being crossed by ARGENTO OCEAN near the 1100 Metres commenced to race keenly. As a result PRIVATE WEALTH improved to the inside of ARGENTO OCEAN and then was checked when left without sufficient room. PRIVATE WEALTH then continued to race keenly throughout the early stages and near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out and made contact with ARGENTO OCEAN. As a result ARGENTO OCEAN and its rider B Avdulla became unbalanced, resulting in ARGENTO OCEAN shifting in and crowding the running of PRIVATE WEALTH. A warning was placed on the racing manners of PRIVATE WEALTH. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.vet_finding: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.note: raced keenly and erratically early; checked near 1100m; shifted out and bumped Argento Ocean near 900m. Official: warning placed on its racing manners; vet nsf

rows.stewards_excuse: The tongue tie was replaced at the Start. In the middle stages raced keenly and approaching the 800 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid AURORA PATCH. Approaching the 400 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out and made contact with ELITE GOLF. C Y Ho reported that when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount did not respond to his riding and raced in a disappointing manner. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.vet_finding: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
rows.note: tongue tie replaced at the start; over-raced and threw its head up near 800m; shifted out and contacted Elite Golf near 400m; disappointing; vet nsf

rows.stewards_excuse: Jumped only fairly. Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between SUPERB SPIRIT and HAR HAR POWER, both of which shifted ground. B Avdulla (AKASHVANI) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of FIT FOR BEAUTY, resulting in FIT FOR BEAUTY being taken in onto SUPERB SPIRIT, resulting in SUPERB SPIRIT losing its running and having to be steadied and also shifting in and crowding the running of PASS LINE, causing PASS LINE to be checked. B Avdulla was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at Happy Valley. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record. Bumped near the 50 Metres.
rows.note: jumped fairly then squeezed after the start between Superb Spirit and Har Har Power; checked again near 900m in the same chain
